questions.stem:
—Where is Tom? I haven't seen him for days.
—He ________ to Beijing. He will come back next week.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查现在完成时have been to与have gone to的区别以及一般过去时的辨析。have gone to表示"去了某地（现在不在说话现场）"，have been to表示"去过某地（现在已经回来）"。根据答句"He will come back next week"可知Tom现在还在北京，没回来，所以选C。A选项went是一般过去时，只强调过去的动作，不表示对现在的影响；B选项has been表示去过已回，与后文矛盾；D选项was going是过去进行时表过去将来，与语境不符。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The boy ________ won the first prize is called Roy.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查定语从句关系代词的选择。先行词是The boy（人），且关系代词在从句中作主语，因此用who。which用于指物；whom用于指人但作宾语；whose表示"谁的"，在从句中作定语。解题口诀：先行词是人作主语用who，作宾语用whom/who；先行词是物用which；whose后常接名词。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The new bridge ________ last year. It is very convenient for us to cross the river now.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查一般过去时的被动语态。主语The new bridge与动词build之间是被动关系（桥被建），且时间状语last year表示过去，因此用一般过去时的被动语态was built。A选项是主动语态一般现在时；B选项是一般现在时被动，时态不符；D选项是过去式或过去分词，缺少助动词，不能构成谓语。被动语态基本结构：be + 过去分词，注意时态变化。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: Could you tell me ________? I want to mail a letter.
options: A. where is the post office
B. where the post office is
C. where was the post office
D. where the post office was
questions.explanation: 这道题考查宾语从句的语序和时态。宾语从句必须使用陈述语序（主语+谓语），排除A和C；主句Could you tell me是委婉请求，不是过去时，从句用一般现在时，因此选B。D选项虽然语序正确，但时态为过去时，与语境不符。解题技巧：宾语从句三步走：1. 看引导词；2. 看语序（必须用陈述语序）；3. 看时态（主现从随便，主过从必过，真理永一现）。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: I ________ a gift from my friend yesterday, but I didn't ________ it because it was too expensive.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查receive与accept的词义辨析。receive表示"客观上收到"，不涉及主观意愿；accept表示"主观上接受"。第一空表示"收到礼物"，用received；第二空表示"不接受"，用accept。A选项第二空receive不符合句意；B、D选项第一空accept使用不当，因为"接受礼物"这个动作是主观决定，但句中yesterday只是客观描述收到这一事实，且后半句明确说没接受。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: We had to ________ the sports meeting because of the heavy rain.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查put短语动词辨析。put off表示"推迟"；put up表示"张贴；搭建；举起"；put on表示"穿上；上演"；put away表示"把……收起来"。根据句意"因为大雨我们不得不推迟运动会"，选B。记忆技巧：off有"离开、远离"之意，put off就是把事情推到以后，远离现在。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: It is ________ for us to finish so much work in such a short time. We need two more days.
questions.explanation: 这道题考查词义辨析及前缀im-的用法。根据后句"We need two more days"可知，在短时间内完成这么多工作对我们来说是不可能的，因此选B（impossible不可能的）。im-是常见的否定前缀，加在possible前构成反义词。A选项possible（可能的）与句意相反；C选项necessary（必要的）和D选项important（重要的）不符合语境逻辑。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 这道题考查语境推理。根据上下文，学校开展绿色项目是为了减少浪费并"促进"回收利用，promote意为"促进、推广"，符合语境。stop（停止）和prevent（阻止）与句意相反；protect（保护）虽然意义相关，但protect recycling搭配不当，通常说protect the environment。

questions.group_passage:
Last month, our school started a green project called "Zero Waste Campus". As a member of the environmental club, I was excited to take part in it. The project aimed to reduce waste and (8)___ recycling among students.

Every morning, volunteers stood at the school gate to give out reusable bags. At first, some students thought it was (9)___ to carry their own bags. However, after (10)___ the harm of plastic bags to the environment, more and more students began to support the idea.

The most challenging part was sorting garbage correctly. We put up colorful posters showing how to separate waste into different bins. For example, food waste went into the green bin, (11)___ paper and plastic went into the blue one. It took us some time to get used to it, but now it has become a habit.

By the end of the term, the amount of waste in our school had (12)___ by 30%. This experience taught us that small actions could make a big difference to our planet.

questions.explanation: 这道题考查语境和情感线索。根据下文However表示转折，以及"more and more students began to support"暗示起初有抵触情绪，可知起初学生认为自带袋子很"麻烦"（troublesome）。easy（容易的）、interesting（有趣的）、necessary（必要的）都不符合转折逻辑。

questions.stem: According to the passage, how many hours of sleep do teenagers need each night?
questions.explanation: 这道题考查细节理解。根据文章第二段第一句"According to a recent study, teenagers need about 8-10 hours of sleep each night"可知，青少年每晚需要8-10小时睡眠，因此选C。细节题解题技巧：关键词定位法，在原文中找到与题干对应的关键词（teenagers need...hours），即可快速定位答案。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Many teenagers love staying up late to play games or chat with friends online. However, scientists have found that lack of sleep can seriously affect teenagers' health and study performance.

According to a recent study, teenagers need about 8-10 hours of sleep each night. During sleep, the brain processes information learned during the day and stores it in memory. Without enough sleep, students may find it hard to concentrate in class and remember new knowledge.

Moreover, sleep deprivation can lead to mood problems. Teenagers who don't sleep well are more likely to feel stressed and anxious. Some may even gain weight because tiredness affects the hormones (荷尔蒙) that control hunger.

Dr. Li, a sleep expert, suggests that teenagers should develop good sleeping habits. "Try to go to bed before 10:30 pm and avoid using electronic devices one hour before sleep," he says. "A good night's sleep is the best preparation for the next day."

questions.stem: What can we infer from Dr. Li's suggestion about electronic devices?
options: A. They help teenagers sleep better
B. They should be avoided before sleep
C. They are necessary for study
D. They store information in memory
questions.explanation: 这道题考查推理判断。根据文章最后一段Dr. Li的建议"avoid using electronic devices one hour before sleep"（避免在睡前一小时使用电子设备），可以推断出电子设备应该在睡前避免使用，因此选B。A选项与文意相反；C选项文中未提及；D选项张冠李戴，文中说的是大脑在睡眠中存储信息，而非电子设备。推理题技巧：答案通常不会直接在原文中出现，需要根据文中信息进行合理推断，注意排除与原文明显矛盾或未提及的选项。

questions.explanation: 这道题考查词义猜测。根据上下文，第三段开头"Moreover"表示递进，承接第二段讨论的睡眠不足问题，且后文"Teenagers who don't sleep well"进一步解释了sleep deprivation指的是睡眠不足，因此deprivation意为"缺乏"（lacking）。A选项（拥有足够）和C选项（享受）与文意相反；D选项（浪费）不符合语境。词义猜测题技巧：利用上下文线索（同义、反义、解释、举例）推断词义，关注连接词如moreover, however等。

options: A. How to Play Games Healthily
